_terminal_outcome_documented._terminal_reachability_rationale: Per FASE 2 raw poll data + live re-capture: (a) the worker IS running (PID 2742692 / worker_id 'YOutube_2742692_worker-7' confirms an in-process worker thread, not a separate cmd/worker binary); (b) the job IS progressing through job_running → progress ×3 (progress=25 before retry) → job_retry_wait within ~30s of submission; (c) retry_count=1 of max_retries=2 means the job WILL naturally reach a terminal state (DEAD_LETTER) after retry exhaustion; (d) BUT the broker rate-limiter blocked the poll loop after ~8 successful polls, hiding any subsequent terminal transition; (e) THEREFORE the user-spec terminal_states set {completed, failed, cancelled, dead_letter} would EVENTUALLY match (DEAD_LETTER after retry exhaustion) but is unobservable in this FASE 2 capture window because of the rate-limit throttle.
_terminal_reachability_alternative_expla: Hypothesis A (REJECTED in v1, INVALIDATED in v2) — jobs broker OFFLINE. Raw poll data proves broker IS accepting requests + writing job events. In-process worker is active.

Hypothesis B (REJECTED in v1, INVALIDATED in v2) — jobs broker UP but worker DOWN. Worker_id 'YOutube_2742692_worker-7' confirmed in the live error envelope AND matches pipelinegen PID 2742692. The worker IS running and processing jobs.
Hypothesis C (REJECTED) — specific job types broken. Both seeded job types progressed; both entered RETRY_WAIT. Job type IRRELEVANT to failure state.

Hypothesis D (PATH-OPEN-BUT-OBSERVATION-THROTTLED, NOT REJECTED) — terminal exit via retry-exhaustion (retry_count=1 of max_retries=2 → 2nd try fails → DEAD_LETTER). The job WILL reach DEAD_LETTER after the 2nd retry fails; this IS the canonical mechanical path to terminal, just BLOCKED-FROM-OBSERVATION by the broker rate-limiter. The user-spec terminal_states set DOES include DEAD_LETTER — so if the throttle weren't blocking, the kill condition WOULD match. NOT a rejection of terminal reachability, but a description of why the observation is non-deterministic in this FASE 2 capture window.

Hypothesis E (CONFIRMED in v2) — the actual missing observation is the sheer RATE of polling combined with broker rate-limit policy. A FUTURE RERUN with PR-POLL-CADENCE-DISCIPLINE (interval jitter ≥ 10s + 429 backoff) would observe the full terminal cycle including DEAD_LETTER.
